name: Birlanu Ltd
title: Birlanu Ltd - 509675 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Pipes margin jumped ~1,300 bps in Q4 on a March resin spike, but FY26 pipes revenue fell 8% on volumes flat; Parador impaired and debt still Rs 851 crores.

utilisation.quote: we are chock-a-block as far as capacity utilization is concerned

capex.quote: the greenfield project on Boards that we are putting up in Nellore will give us additional capacity

triggers.label: Pipes Q4 margin +1,300 bps on resin spike
triggers.quote: margins improved sharply during quarter 4 by nearly 1,300 basis points mainly due to steep price increase in the resin prices in the month of March
triggers.highlight: margins improved sharply during quarter 4 by nearly 1,300 basis points

triggers.label: Walls capacity fully utilised
triggers.quote: in both those segments, in fact, even in Blocks, we are chock-a-block as far as capacity utilization is concerned
triggers.highlight: chock-a-block as far as capacity utilization

triggers.label: Pipes Q4 volume growth 2-3%
triggers.quote: Pipes volume growth is in the zone of about 2% to 3%
triggers.highlight: Pipes volume growth is in the zone of about 2% to 3%

guidance.quote: We expect prices to stabilize over the coming months and anticipate a stronger recovery in FY27

guidance.value: bounce back on sales in FY27
guidance.quote: I think what we should expect is a bounce back on sales, which then has a positive flow-through on profitability
